ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a green triangle, and the base is the horizontal segment at the lower right, labeled 16 yd. The vertex of the triangle is at the upper left, and from this vertex a pink dashed line is drawn downward perpendicular to the horizontal straight line containing the base, with the dashed line length labeled 10 yd; the foot of the perpendicular falls on the leftward extension of the triangle's base. The figure also labels 8 yd and hypotenuse 26 yd, but they are not the data needed to find the area by the specified method. Reasoning: The triangle area formula is A = 1/2 × b × h. Take base b = 16 yd, and the corresponding perpendicular height h = 10 yd. Calculate A = 1/2 × 16 × 10 = 80. Therefore the area is 80 square yards.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a single green triangle whose bottom side is the horizontal segment labeled 16 yd. The dashed vertical segment from the top vertex down to the extension of the base line is labeled 10 yd, so it is the perpendicular height to that horizontal base line even though the foot falls outside the triangle. Use the text instruction to find the area. Apply the triangle area formula A = (1/2)bh with b = 16 and h = 10, giving A = 80.

推理：三角形面积公式为 A = 1/2 × b × h。取底边 b = 16 yd，对应的垂直高 h = 10 yd。计算 A = 1/2 × 16 × 10 = 80。因此面积为 80 平方码。

method.method_draft: Read the image as the green triangle embedded in a larger right triangle formed by the top vertex, the dashed altitude foot, and the far-right bottom vertex.
